an4.273:2.1: Attanā ca sammādiṭṭhiko hoti parañ ca sammādiṭṭhiyā samādapeti sammādiṭṭhiyā ca samanuñño hoti sammādiṭṭhiyā ca vaṇṇaṃ bhāsati.
an4.273:2.2: Ime kho catuhi dhammehi samannāgato yathābhataṃ nikkhitto evaṃ sagge ti. 271. 1.
